title: Extremely small
text: Extremely small. Teeny tiny! Measure your space and really consider if this provides enough room for your items. Also, the shelve moves as 1 piece. The top does not slide out independently of the bottom and vice versa. This bugs me. All the hardware is included. As are mats for the bottom of the shelves so nothing slips thru.

product_metadata.title: G-TING Pull Out Spice Rack Organizer for Cabinet, 2-Tier Slide Out Kitchen Cabinets and Pantry Closet Storage Shelf 8.6" W 10.4" D 9" H for Spices, Sauces, Bottle, Shot Glasses, Food and Cans, Chrome
features: ➻【SPICE RACK ORGANIZER FOR CABINETS】 If you can't stand the mess of spices and bottles on the table, you can try our spice rack. It can be hidden in the kitchen cabinet, all small items can be organized and put into the cabinet, saving desktop space, and now you can put more spices and bottles in the cabinet

➻【SLIDING & LIGHTWEIGHT GUIDE RAIL】 The high-quality fully extended ball bearings ensure smooth and easy sliding, and you can fully contact all the spices and bottles in the upper cabinet during the extended sliding motion. The unique sliding-out design allows you to find items that you need quickly even in the deeper upper cabinet, improving efficiency and saving your time

➻【CONVENIENT HOLLOW DESIGN 】 The line structure hollow design, you can easily find the items you need even if you put it in the shelf, which is convenient for viewing and storing. The non-slip design can prevent small accessories or accidentally spilled spices from falling, and will never affect the mood of cooking due to sudden situations

➻【DURABLE & HEAVY-DUTY 】 The pull-out cabinet organizer is made of commercial large-scale heavy-duty chrome-plated wire, which is sturdy, has good anti-rust effect and strong bearing capacity. Slide out spice rack for citchen has strong anti-wear properties and can be wiped clean with a towel, so you never have to worry about cleaning difficulties

➻【EASY TO INSTALL 】 According to the steps in the manual, only a few simple screws are required. You can get a cabinet organizer in 30 minutes. Please be careful not to be smaller than the minimum size of 10.5"W 11.5"D 13"H. Need to punch holes to fit the screws.
